rationale: The round 3 exchanges added expert clarification and sharper boundary-setting, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and Lower Saxony still insist on no closures/forced redundancies, while management and capital still require quantified structural cost and capacity cuts and keep closures on the table. The discussion is now circling around the same incompatible positions with only procedural convergence, so an external intervention or hard quantitative site-by-site analysis is needed rather than another generic bargaining round.
